name: @cs-herramientas/sidof-ingestion
description: Comandos de carga y sincronización del tipo de cambio SIDOF

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.clean:test: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist/test', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.backfill: pnpm run build && node dist/cli.js backfill
scripts.sync: pnpm run build && node dist/cli.js sync
scripts.test: pnpm run clean:test && pnpm run build && node --test dist/test/*.test.js
